entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane themed around the conflict between its dragons and the humanoid clans, where dragonstorms now pour out new dragons.

entities.name: Dragonstorm Arc
entities.description: The story arc concluded by this set.

entities.name: Abzan Houses
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir with the Endure mechanic.

entities.name: Jeskai Way
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir with the Flurry mechanic.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir with the Renew mechanic.

entities.name: Mardu Horde
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir with the Mobilize mechanic.

entities.name: Temur Frontier
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir with the Harmonize mechanic.

entities.name: Dragonlords
entities.description: The elder dragons who had ruled Tarkir and are overthrown by the clans.

entities.name: Spirit dragons
entities.description: Five new dragons that replace the elder dragonlords after the Stormnexus Ritual and that the clans learn to summon and bind.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Storms that pour out a new breed of dragons and render large areas of Tarkir uninhabitable.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: The event after which the elder dragonlords were replaced by five new spirit dragons.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths that dragons' wings rip through and through which uncontrolled dragons can escape Tarkir.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: A realm with unique powers that Jace intends to use to reshape the Multiverse.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrives on Tarkir and tries to reshape the Multiverse, losing control and appearing to become connected to the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A desparked planeswalker whose research lets the clans summon and bind spirit dragons.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker who confronts Jace in the Meditation Realm with Narset.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A companion who accompanies Jace to Tarkir.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A character who accompanies Jace to Tarkir.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker who returns to quell the dragonstorms and struggles against Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who recovers his name and escapes after the conflict in the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Sarkhan
entities.description: A desparked planeswalker.

events.summary: After the Stormnexus Ritual, the elder dragonlords are replaced by five new spirit dragons, and a new breed of dragons pours out through dragonstorms.
events.quote: After the Stormnexus Ritual , the elder dragonlords have been replaced by five new spirit dragons .

events.summary: Through Narset's research, the clans learn to summon and bind spirit dragons and overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane.
events.quote: the clans were able to overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane

events.summary: The new dragonstorms render large areas uninhabitable and spawn uncontrolled dragons that can escape Tarkir through the Omenpaths.
events.quote: render large areas uninhabitable and spawn new, uncontrolled dragons

events.summary: Jace arrives on Tarkir with Loot and Vraska and travels to the Meditation Realm to reshape the Multiverse.
events.quote: He intends to use the unique powers of the Meditation Realm to reshape the Multiverse

events.summary: Narset and Elspeth confront Jace in the Meditation Realm and he loses control of its powers.
events.quote: but is confronted there by Narset and Elspeth and loses control of those powers

events.summary: The conflict tips the balance between Ugin and Nicol Bolas; Bolas recovers his name and escapes, while Jace appears to become connected to the Meditation Realm.
events.quote: Bolas recovers his name and escapes, while Jace appears to become connected to the Meditation Realm.

events.summary: Ugin returns to quell the dragonstorms.
events.quote: Ugin returns to quell the dragonstorms

relations.note: her research helps the clans of Tarkir
relations.quote: The clans of Tarkir, through the research of the desparked planeswalker Narset

relations.note: she confronts him in the Meditation Realm
relations.quote: but is confronted there by Narset and Elspeth
